scope: T6: Polish & Launch epic — 7 wogiflow-cloud commits (8cc2746..d9f4e82) + 2 wogi-flow commits (de98950, 5893ace)

findings.issue: require('./response') broken path — should be require('../lib/response'). Runtime MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash.
findings.recommendation: Change to require('../lib/response')

findings.issue: require('./response') broken path — same as anomalies.js. Runtime crash.
findings.recommendation: Change to require('../lib/response')

findings.issue: checkMembership and logAudit imported from ../lib/auth but they live in ../lib/teams. Both are undefined at runtime — every anomaly endpoint crashes.
findings.recommendation: Split: requireAuth from ../lib/auth, checkMembership+logAudit from ../lib/teams

findings.issue: Same wrong import as anomalies.js — checkMembership from ../lib/auth is undefined.
findings.recommendation: Split imports: requireAuth from ../lib/auth, checkMembership from ../lib/teams

findings.issue: getPatternVelocity and getHealthScore imported but lib/health.js exports getPatternVelocityByProject and computeHealthScore. Two endpoints crash at runtime.
findings.recommendation: Update import names to match actual exports

findings.issue: Auth bypass: uses user._unauthorized check but requireAuth returns {response, auth}. _unauthorized is always undefined — unauthenticated requests pass through.
findings.recommendation: Use standard pattern: const authResult = await requireAuth(event); if (authResult.response) return authResult.response;

findings.issue: Open redirect: unvalidated RelayState from SAML POST redirects user with access token appended to attacker-controlled URL.
findings.recommendation: Validate RelayState against allowlisted origins before redirecting

findings.issue: SAML NotBefore not checked — accepts future-dated assertions. No InResponseTo validation — response injection possible.
findings.recommendation: Add NotBefore check and InResponseTo verification with request ID cache

findings.issue: Unvalidated body.status flows into audit action string and SQL. No allowlist check — audit log injection possible.
findings.recommendation: Validate status against Set(['acknowledged', 'resolved', 'open'])

findings.issue: CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on sensitive audit export endpoint.
findings.recommendation: Replace wildcard with specific dashboard origin

findings.issue: .workflow/team-connection.json not in .gitignore — tokens can be committed to VCS.
findings.recommendation: Add .workflow/team-connection.json to .gitignore

findings.issue: membership.id is undefined (checkMembership returns {isMember, role}). resolvedBy never stored.
findings.recommendation: Use auth.userId instead of membership.id

findings.issue: logAudit called with (teamId, userId, ...) but signature is (userId, teamId, ...). Arguments swapped — corrupts audit log.
findings.recommendation: Swap to logAudit(auth.userId, teamId, ...)

findings.issue: Reads data.onlineMembers and data.findingsToday but API returns onlineCount and reviewFindingsToday. Summary cards always show 0.
findings.recommendation: Update field names to match API response

findings.issue: getPresence(teamId) but function expects projectId. Presence panel always returns empty.
findings.recommendation: Pass projectId or redesign to support team-level presence queries

findings.issue: Scan response returns 'count' but dashboard reads 'anomaliesFound'. Scan results always show 0.
findings.recommendation: Align field name: use anomaliesFound in response

findings.issue: CSV formula injection: escapeCsvField doesn't strip =, +, -, @ prefixes.
findings.recommendation: Prefix formula-trigger characters with single quote

findings.issue: ReDoS: dynamic regex with [\s\S]*? on attacker-influenced XML. No size limit on decoded SAML response.
findings.recommendation: Add XML size limit and replace regex with XML parser or bound quantifiers

findings.issue: Bearer token input is type='text' (visible) while anomalies.html uses type='password'.
findings.recommendation: Change to type='password'

findings.issue: INSERT then unconditional UPDATE doubles count on first insert.
findings.recommendation: Use single INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE upsert

findings.issue: Velocity self-join missing c.created_at > s.created_at — negative durations possible. Multi-start tasks produce Cartesian product.
findings.recommendation: Add timestamp constraint and use DISTINCT ON

findings.issue: Compliance rate uses all-time violation event count vs current rule count — produces 0% for any active project.
findings.recommendation: Count distinct rules violated in time window, not raw event count

findings.issue: Activity feed reads entry.memberName, entry.actor, entry.description, entry.timestamp — none exist in API response.
findings.recommendation: Use entry.userName, entry.action, entry.createdAt

findings.issue: Sends projectId= but server reads qs.project. Project filter silently ignored.
findings.recommendation: Change param to &project= or change server to read qs.projectId

findings.issue: Reads s.text and s.type but API returns s.term only. Typeahead renders blank items.
findings.recommendation: Use s.term instead of s.text

findings.issue: components->>'debt' always NULL — correct JSONB path is components->'debtTrend'->>'currentCount'.
findings.recommendation: Fix JSONB path to match lib/health.js storage shape

findings.issue: components->>'compliance' returns JSON object string not number — parseFloat returns NaN. Compliance drop detection broken.
findings.recommendation: Use (components->'compliance'->>'rate')::numeric

findings.issue: parseJsonBody returns {body, error} but assigned to plain 'body'. All PATCH requests return 400.
findings.recommendation: Destructure: const { body, error } = parseJsonBody(event)

findings.issue: N+1 query: 5N concurrent DB queries for N members in getMemberOnboardingStatus. 250 queries for 50 members.
findings.recommendation: Batch with GROUP BY queries per metric or add concurrency limit

findings.issue: Token refresh race condition: concurrent 401s both try to refresh, second uses invalidated token.
findings.recommendation: Implement module-level in-flight refresh promise deduplication

findings.issue: Auth imports from ../lib/auth while other T6 routes split between ../lib/auth and ../lib/teams. Inconsistent pattern.
findings.recommendation: Standardize all routes to split: requireAuth from auth, checkMembership+logAudit from teams
